findings.detail: The functional HTML export has a correct current file hash and is declared requires_generation_lineage=false in the registry, but the current asset schema still requires width, height, generation_record_id, raw_source_path, and derivation_operations on every export object.
findings.semantic_verifier_boundary: validate_assets.verify does not enforce those five structural fields for HTML, so the scoped 67-family verifier passes and the full verifier returns only the five expected Not verified errors. This is an additional strict-schema defect and must be reconciled before claiming all 72 entries schema-valid.
findings.reviewer_action: Recorded only; no manifest or schema edit was authorized in this review.
